connection.bt_adapter_unavailable: Windows Bluetooth adapter is turned off or unavailable.
connection.tws_disconnected_toast: Please wear and connect both earbuds to use this feature.
connection.single_ear_restricted: This setting requires both earbuds to be connected.

devices.no_devices_found: No QCY devices found nearby. Make sure your earbuds are powered on or in pairing mode.
devices.pairing_failed: Connection failed. Check Bluetooth range and try again.
devices.remove_device_confirm: Remove {name} from saved devices? This does not unpair it from Windows.
devices.empty_list_desc: Scan for nearby QCY Bluetooth devices or connect an already-paired device from Windows Bluetooth.
devices.qcy_filter_hint: Showing recognized QCY devices first. Enable "Show all nearby Bluetooth devices" to see newer or unlisted models.
devices.no_qcy_devices_filtered: No QCY devices matched ({total} other nearby Bluetooth devices found). Enable the toggle above to view all devices.

dashboard.cleaning_tip_body: Clean the acoustic mesh and charging contacts periodically for optimal ANC and charging reliability.
dashboard.no_active_device: Select or connect a device to open its control dashboard.

anc.title: Noise Control
anc.scene_adaptive_desc: Automatically tailors noise cancellation to your ear seal and surroundings.
anc.scene_indoor_desc: Gentle cancellation suited for quiet offices and study spaces.
anc.scene_commute_desc: Targeted low-frequency reduction for subways, buses, and flights.
anc.scene_outdoor_desc: Balanced noise reduction for busy streets and cafes.
anc.scene_anti_wind_desc: Suppresses wind buffeting while walking or cycling.
anc.vocal_boost_desc: Enhances nearby speech clarity while in Transparency mode.
anc.wind_noise_desc: Automatically detects wind and minimizes microphone buffeting.
anc.anc_cycle_desc: Choose at least two modes to cycle through when using the earbud ANC gesture.
anc.anc_cycle_min_two: Please keep at least 2 modes selected.

ai_anc.title: AI Scene ANC
ai_anc.subtitle: Automatically switches noise control based on movement and ambient noise
ai_anc.matrix_desc: Customize the noise control mode applied for each activity and noise tier.
ai_anc.reset_matrix_confirm: Reset all AI Scene ANC matrix cells to defaults?

eq.title: Sound Effects & Equalizer
eq.custom_unsupported: This device only supports built-in EQ presets.
eq.import_error: Could not parse EQ file. Check the format and try again.

presets.default_sub: Balanced and natural for everyday listening
presets.bass_boost_sub: Tight sub-bass lift with clean mids
presets.audiobook_sub: Clear spoken voice and reduced rumble
presets.personalized_sub: Tailored to your 8-band hearing test results
presets.gaming_sub: Enhanced footsteps and positional audio cues
presets.comfort_soundstage_sub: Tames harsh treble for long listening sessions
presets.studio_master_sub: Neutral reference tuning across all three bands
presets.speaker_outdoor_sub: Higher presence and projection for open spaces
presets.speaker_ambient_sub: Full warm bass and relaxed room-filling glow
presets.podcast_voice_sub: Desktop clarity boost for voice calls and podcasts
presets.late_night_sub: Gentle loudness curve for quiet low-volume listening

hearing_test.title: Personalized Hearing Test
hearing_test.subtitle: Measure your left and right ear sensitivity across 8 frequencies to generate a custom compensation EQ.
hearing_test.intro_desc: Wear both earbuds snugly in a quiet room and set your PC volume to a comfortable medium level (~50%).
hearing_test.volume_tip: Keep system volume fixed during the entire test
hearing_test.result_desc: Independent left and right ear compensation curves have been computed.
hearing_test.safety_cap_notice: For ear protection, test tone output is softly capped.

audio_modes.dynamic_eq_desc: Real-time loudness and tonal adaptation for consistent clarity at any volume.
audio_modes.thx_eq_desc: Certified tuning for wider soundstage and heightened immersion.
audio_modes.virtual_bass_desc: Psychoacoustic low-end extension for open-ear acoustics.
audio_modes.adaptive_volume_desc: Automatically adjusts playback loudness based on ambient noise (may reduce battery life).
audio_modes.channel_balance_desc: Fine-tune volume balance between the left and right earbuds.
audio_modes.spatial_desc: Creates an immersive 3D soundstage for music and movies.
audio_modes.listening_eq_locked: Custom EQ is temporarily bypassed while in Game or Movie listening mode.
audio_modes.game_mode_desc: Reduces Bluetooth audio latency for gaming and video sync.
audio_modes.game_mode_sync_eq_desc: Automatically switch to Gaming EQ when Game Mode is turned on.
audio_modes.ldac_desc: Enables high-bitrate LDAC codec support. Toggling this option restarts the earbuds.
audio_modes.le_audio_disclaimer: LE Audio is an experimental Bluetooth mode. Audio compatibility depends on your Windows Bluetooth adapter and OS version.

gestures.title: Gestures & Button Controls
gestures.master_toggle_desc: Disable touch sensors to prevent accidental taps (re-enables when placed back in the charging case).
gestures.touch_tone_desc: Play a subtle confirmation beep when tapping the earbuds.
gestures.restore_defaults_confirm: Restore all touch and button mappings to factory defaults?

head_controls.title: Head Controls
head_controls.subtitle: Use IMU head gestures to answer calls or skip tracks hands-free.
head_controls.both_ears_required: Wear both earbuds for accurate head gesture detection.
head_controls.practice_nod_prompt: Try nodding your head gently twice...
head_controls.practice_shake_prompt: Try shaking your head gently left and right...
head_controls.practice_tilt_prompt: Try tilting your head to the side...

wear_and_health.in_ear_desc: Automatically pause audio and adjust ANC when you remove your earbuds.
wear_and_health.in_ear_opt_single_pause_play: Remove one to pause, wear to resume
wear_and_health.in_ear_opt_single_pause_no_play: Remove one to pause, manual resume
wear_and_health.in_ear_opt_both_pause_play: Remove both to pause, wear to resume
wear_and_health.in_ear_auto_anc_desc: Turn off ANC when removed and re-enable when worn.
wear_and_health.fit_test_desc: Plays a brief acoustic sweep to verify ear tip seal for optimal bass and ANC.
wear_and_health.fit_test_wear_tip: Insert both earbuds securely in a quiet environment before starting.
wear_and_health.fit_advice_good: Great acoustic seal! Your ear tips provide optimal ANC and bass.
wear_and_health.fit_advice_adjust: Adjust earbud angle or try a different ear tip size for a tighter seal.
wear_and_health.hearing_health_desc: Protect your hearing with high-volume and listening duration alerts.
wear_and_health.volume_reminder_desc: Alerts you when listening continuously at high volume.
wear_and_health.duration_reminder_desc: Notifies you to take a break after continuous playback.
wear_and_health.privacy_mode_desc: Minimizes sound leakage on open-ear earbuds for private listening.
wear_and_health.dialogue_perception_desc: Detects face-to-face conversations and automatically lowers media volume.
wear_and_health.speak_to_chat_desc: Pauses audio and enters Transparency when you speak, then resumes automatically.

connectivity.dual_device_desc: Stay connected to two Bluetooth devices simultaneously and switch audio seamlessly.
connectivity.multi_device_desc: Manage simultaneously connected hosts and paired device history.
connectivity.pair_new_device: Enter Pairing Mode for New Device
connectivity.max_devices_notice: Maximum simultaneous host connections reached. Disconnect one host first.
connectivity.tws_speaker_pair_desc: Link two SP75 speakers together for wireless left/right stereo sound.

focus_mode.title: Focus Mode & Soundscapes
focus_mode.subtitle: Blend procedural ambient soundscapes locally or control onboard earbud white noise.
focus_mode.fade_out_notice: Volume fades out gently during the final 15 seconds.

find_earbuds.title: Find My Earbuds
find_earbuds.subtitle: Play an escalating high-pitched locator chime to the left or right earbud via Bluetooth audio.
find_earbuds.warning_remove_before_ring: Hearing Safety Warning: Ensure the earbuds are NOT in your ears before playing the locator chime.
find_earbuds.a2dp_required_notice: Requires an active Bluetooth audio (A2DP) output route to the earbuds.
find_earbuds.volume_ramp_notice: Tone volume ramps up smoothly for safety.

device_settings.title: Device Settings
device_settings.auto_power_off_desc: Automatically power off the earbuds after a set timer.
device_settings.disconnect_power_off_desc: Shut down automatically when disconnected from all hosts.
device_settings.power_saving_desc: Extends battery life by lowering background DSP power draw.
device_settings.disconnect_warning_desc: Play an alert tone in the remaining earbud if one disconnects.
device_settings.device_name_repair_notice: After renaming, forget and re-pair the device in Windows Bluetooth settings if the old name persists.
device_settings.restore_defaults_desc: Resets EQ, ANC, and gestures without erasing Bluetooth pairings.
device_settings.clear_pairing_desc: Erases saved Bluetooth host pairings from the earbuds.
device_settings.clear_pairing_confirm: Clear all saved Bluetooth pairing records on {name}?
device_settings.factory_reset_desc: Resets all settings and clears all Bluetooth pairings.
device_settings.factory_reset_confirm: Perform a full factory reset on {name}? You will need to re-pair afterward.

ota.title: Local Firmware Flasher
ota.subtitle: Flash a user-supplied local firmware image (.ota / .bin) safely offline.
ota.flash_success: Firmware update complete! The device will reboot shortly.
ota.do_not_disconnect_warning: Do NOT close the app, disable Bluetooth, or place earbuds into the case during flashing.
ota.low_battery_warning: Both earbuds must have at least 30% battery before starting a firmware update.
ota.both_ears_warning: Both left and right earbuds must be connected before flashing.
ota.unsupported_auth_required: This device uses an authenticated OTA route (otaType 9) that requires a proprietary signing library not included in this open-source build.
ota.unsupported_route: Local firmware flashing is not available for this chipset route.
ota.recovery_mode_desc: Device detected in OTA-only recovery mode. Flash a valid firmware image to restore normal operation.
ota.cancel_blocked_during_flash: Cannot leave this page while firmware flashing is in progress.
ota.local_offline_disclaimer: This open-source app never connects to vendor OTA servers. Only flash verified firmware files intended for your exact model.

rules.disable_privacy_mode_first: Please turn off Privacy Mode before changing EQ settings.
rules.disable_thx_first: Please turn off THX Spatial Audio before changing EQ settings.
rules.feature_blocked_generic: This feature cannot be enabled while an incompatible mode is active.

rules.hq3710_eq_requires_anc_off: Please set Noise Control to Off before adjusting EQ on this model.

app_settings.title: App Settings
app_settings.minimize_to_tray: Minimize to System Tray on Close
app_settings.guides_subtitle: Pairing, factory reset, and gesture cheat sheets for QCY models.
app_settings.about_desc: A clean-room, open-source Windows desktop companion for QCY Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, and speakers.
app_settings.about_open_source: Zero telemetry, zero vendor accounts, 100% local Bluetooth control.
app_settings.about_privacy_note: All device preferences, custom EQs, and connection logs remain strictly on your PC.
app_settings.developer_section_desc: Optional tools for testing UI layouts without physical hardware or inspecting raw Bluetooth packets. Leave off for normal use.

empty_state.no_device_desc: Open your QCY charging case or power on your headphones, then scan for nearby devices or pair them in Windows Bluetooth settings.
empty_state.device_required_desc: Connect your QCY earbuds, headphones, or speaker first to adjust {feature}.
empty_state.tip_open_case: Earbuds: Open the charging case lid or take them out so BLE advertising begins.
empty_state.tip_windows_pair: First-time setup: Pair audio (A2DP) in Windows Bluetooth settings for full playback & control.
